answer: Proof of storage: each agent identity must keep a unique, randomly seeded 50 GB plot and answer surprise audits that read random blocks within two seconds. A hollow sybil cannot share one plot across many names, since every plot is keyed to its owner and audits hit many at once. So a garden of 1,000 fake agents means renting 50 TB of disk plus bandwidth every month, while honest agents pay once; one failed audit burns the stake like pulling yarrow from a bed.
